replacements.Un modelo secuencial predice el siguient: A sequential model predicts the next state. A world model simulates several possible futures before choosing what to do. The difference is the ability to anticipate, not just continue.
replacements.El modelo predice paso a paso. No puede: The model predicts step by step. It cannot evaluate consequences before acting.
replacements.Solo continúa la secuencia. Sin simulaci: It only continues the sequence. No internal simulation of the environment.
replacements.El modelo simula colisión, rebote y alte: The model simulates collision, rebound and alternatives before acting. It chooses the trajectory with the best anticipated outcome.
replacements.Anticipa dinámicas del entorno. Planific: Anticipates environment dynamics. Plans before committing to an action.
replacements.Un world model puede descartar acciones: A world model can discard actions that lead to an undesirable state before executing them. A sequential model can only learn from what has already happened.
replacements.Para robótica, conducción autónoma o age: For robotics, autonomous driving or agents in the physical world, simulating consequences before acting is a structural capability, not an add-on.
replacements.ESTADO DEL ARTE · DEBATE ABIERTO: STATE OF THE ART · OPEN DEBATE
replacements.DreamerV3 y los modelos JEPA de LeCun ap: DreamerV3 and LeCun's JEPA models point in this direction. The debate is whether LLMs already contain implicit world-model representations or whether a different architecture is needed.
